name: The Farm
tagline: The Farm — Falls Creek Produce and Flowers
description: The Farm is a pumpkin patch in Alpena, MI. Visitors come for Strawberries, Raspberries, and Pumpkins, best in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
